description: Maryland statewide real property assessments (State Department of Assessments and Taxation with Maryland Department of Planning, via the state open data portal opendata.maryland.gov) for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/data-policy.md and the review record in docs/registry/sources/md-sdat-real-property.md.

sources.publisher: Maryland State Department of Assessments and Taxation (SDAT) and Maryland Department of Planning (MDP), via opendata.maryland.gov
sources.license: Portal license field: 'Public Domain' (licenseId PUBLIC_DOMAIN) on dataset ed4q-f8tm 'Maryland Real Property Assessments_Hidden Property Owner Names'; attribution field: 'SDAT (State Department of Assessments and Taxation) and MDP (Maryland Department of Planning)'
sources.ai_use: Not restricted and not addressed: the dataset documentation (Real_Property_Records_Documentation.pdf) carries only an accuracy disclaimer
sources.redistribution: Permitted (public domain per the portal license field); attribution given anyway: Maryland State Department of Assessments and Taxation and Maryland Department of Planning, via opendata.maryland.gov
sources.notes: Statewide Socrata dataset ed4q-f8tm (24 jurisdictions, about 2.5 million accounts), one row per tax account, updated monthly on or about the 3rd. The publisher WITHHOLDS OWNER NAMES by design (the dataset title says 'Hidden Property Owner Names'; the 223 columns carry no owner name and no owner address, only the owner-occupancy code). The files here are server-side filtered with SoQL to the commercial scope (land use C, CC, I, M) and to the 33 columns the adapter reads, one file per jurisdiction: the three Tier 2 counties (Montgomery 24031, Prince George's 24033, Baltimore County 24005) first, then, from the statewide extension of 2026-11-03, the other 20 counties and Baltimore City (24510, 'Baltimore City' in the same column) alphabetically: 24 files. In-scope accounts on 2026-11-03 (SoQL group-by): 109,255 statewide; the largest file is Baltimore City's 14,837 rows. The full unfiltered export is far larger than 50 MB and is not used. robots.txt on opendata.maryland.gov: Crawl-delay 1; Disallow only for browse/catalog URLs with q=, category=, sortBy= and similar parameters, /OData.svc/, /api/odata/, /login, /tiles/; the resource and api/views endpoints are allowed. Companion dataset w8th-47fz (Fields Reference) lists every column. The SDAT business entity register is NOT here: see md-sdat-entities.
